text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, of course. You may certainly get 
your hopes up.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I will deliver a race that makes Mom and 
Dad proud, without fail. ...Yes, see you 
later then.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'll get to show off the fruits of my 
hard work right in front of my parents.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: How could I not be delighted...? Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Now... shall we go and offer up a flawless 
victory that crushes all in our path?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the race approaching, Dream Journey's 
gaze grew razor-sharp!
